annotations.title: HTML table to JSON: extract tables from HTML

description: Extract every table from an HTML fragment into JSON: header cells become keys and each body row an object (or raw arrays when there is no header row), with captions, colspans repeated and entities decoded. Give the HTML itself (up to 500 KB). Use to turn web or email tables into data an agent can sort and compute on; to fetch a page first use extract. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
